options.content: Mirrors the DORA lead-time investigation. Stage timings come from raw review events with bots excluded. See the notes panel at the bottom before quoting numbers.

panels.title: Stage durations at p50 / p75 / p90
panels.description: What a PR experiences per stage. The median PR is fast everywhere; the tails belong to deploy and coding. Stage medians do NOT sum to the median lead time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prs AS (
  SELECT m.id, MAX(m.pr_cycle_time)/60 cycle, MAX(COALESCE(m.pr_coding_time,0))/60 coding,
         MAX(COALESCE(m.pr_deploy_time,0))/60 deploy, MAX(m.pr_deployed_date) merged
  FROM project_pr_metrics m
  WHERE m.pr_deployed_date IS NOT NULL AND m.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
    AND m.project_name IN (${project})
    AND (m.is_authored_by_bot IS NULL OR m.is_authored_by_bot IN (${author_type}))
    AND m.deployment_commit_id NOT LIKE '%01KTRWDKFENWZXRRF10DCEPRQ9%'
    AND $__timeFilter(m.pr_deployed_date)
  GROUP BY m.id
), ev AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('github:GithubPullRequest:2:', rv.pull_request_id) pid,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_rev,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.state='APPROVED' AND rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_appr
  FROM _tool_github_pull_request_reviews rv GROUP BY rv.pull_request_id
), stages AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.cycle, p.coding, p.deploy, p.merged,
    CASE WHEN e.first_rev IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, e.first_rev),0)/60 END pickup,
    CASE WHEN e.first_rev IS NOT NULL AND e.first_appr IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.first_rev, e.first_appr),0)/60 END review_appr,
    CASE WHEN e.first_appr IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.first_appr, pr.merged_date),0)/60 END merge_wait,
    GREATEST(p.cycle - p.coding - p.deploy, 0) om
  FROM prs p JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = p.id LEFT JOIN ev e ON e.pid = p.id
)
SELECT ord, stage, p50, p75, p90 FROM (
SELECT 1 ord, 'Coding' stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.50 THEN v END),1) p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.75 THEN v END),1) p75,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.90 THEN v END),1) p90
FROM (SELECT coding v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY coding) rk FROM stages WHERE coding IS NOT NULL) t1
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 ord, 'Pickup' stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.50 THEN v END),1) p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.75 THEN v END),1) p75,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.90 THEN v END),1) p90
FROM (SELECT pickup v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pickup) rk FROM stages WHERE pickup IS NOT NULL) t2
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 ord, 'Review to approval' stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.50 THEN v END),1) p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.75 THEN v END),1) p75,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.90 THEN v END),1) p90
FROM (SELECT review_appr v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY review_appr) rk FROM stages WHERE review_appr IS NOT NULL) t3
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 ord, 'Approval to merge' stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.50 THEN v END),1) p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.75 THEN v END),1) p75,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.90 THEN v END),1) p90
FROM (SELECT merge_wait v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY merge_wait) rk FROM stages WHERE merge_wait IS NOT NULL) t4
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 ord, 'Deploy' stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.50 THEN v END),1) p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.75 THEN v END),1) p75,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.90 THEN v END),1) p90
FROM (SELECT deploy v, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deploy) rk FROM stages WHERE deploy IS NOT NULL) t5
) u ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Which stages matter, by lead-time band
panels.description: Disjoint slices of the lead-time ranking (no PR in two bands). Each stage shown as percent of the band's total hours: percentiles group the PRs, averages describe the group. Around the median, pickup dominates; in the tail, deploy and coding take over.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prs AS (
  SELECT m.id, MAX(m.pr_cycle_time)/60 cycle, MAX(COALESCE(m.pr_coding_time,0))/60 coding,
         MAX(COALESCE(m.pr_deploy_time,0))/60 deploy, MAX(m.pr_deployed_date) merged
  FROM project_pr_metrics m
  WHERE m.pr_deployed_date IS NOT NULL AND m.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
    AND m.project_name IN (${project})
    AND (m.is_authored_by_bot IS NULL OR m.is_authored_by_bot IN (${author_type}))
    AND m.deployment_commit_id NOT LIKE '%01KTRWDKFENWZXRRF10DCEPRQ9%'
    AND $__timeFilter(m.pr_deployed_date)
  GROUP BY m.id
), ev AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('github:GithubPullRequest:2:', rv.pull_request_id) pid,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_rev,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.state='APPROVED' AND rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_appr
  FROM _tool_github_pull_request_reviews rv GROUP BY rv.pull_request_id
), stages AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.cycle, p.coding, p.deploy, p.merged,
    CASE WHEN e.first_rev IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, e.first_rev),0)/60 END pickup,
    CASE WHEN e.first_rev IS NOT NULL AND e.first_appr IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.first_rev, e.first_appr),0)/60 END review_appr,
    CASE WHEN e.first_appr IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.first_appr, pr.merged_date),0)/60 END merge_wait,
    GREATEST(p.cycle - p.coding - p.deploy, 0) om
  FROM prs p JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = p.id LEFT JOIN ev e ON e.pid = p.id
),
norm AS (
  SELECT s.*, NTILE(100) OVER (ORDER BY cycle) pct,
    CASE WHEN pickup IS NULL THEN om ELSE pickup * om / NULLIF(pickup + COALESCE(review_appr,0) + COALESCE(merge_wait,0),0) END pk_n,
    CASE WHEN pickup IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(review_appr,0) * om / NULLIF(pickup + COALESCE(review_appr,0) + COALESCE(merge_wait,0),0) END ra_n,
    CASE WHEN pickup IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(merge_wait,0) * om / NULLIF(pickup + COALESCE(review_appr,0) + COALESCE(merge_wait,0),0) END am_n
  FROM stages s WHERE cycle > 0
)
SELECT CASE WHEN pct BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN '1 p40-p60' WHEN pct BETWEEN 66 AND 85 THEN '2 p65-p85' ELSE '3 p85-p95' END band,
  ROUND(100*SUM(coding)/SUM(cycle),0) 'Coding', ROUND(100*SUM(COALESCE(pk_n,0))/SUM(cycle),0) 'Pickup',
  ROUND(100*SUM(COALESCE(ra_n,0))/SUM(cycle),0) 'Review to approval',
  ROUND(100*SUM(COALESCE(am_n,0))/SUM(cycle),0) 'Approval to merge', ROUND(100*SUM(deploy)/SUM(cycle),0) 'Deploy'
FROM norm
WHERE pct BETWEEN 41 AND 60 OR pct BETWEEN 66 AND 85 OR pct BETWEEN 86 AND 95
GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

panels.title: By team
panels.description: Teams with 40+ PRs in range. Excess above company median: positive pushes the company median up. Multi-project PRs count once per project.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prs_t AS (
  SELECT m.id, REPLACE(m.project_name, ': default', '') proj, m.pr_cycle_time/60 cycle,
         COALESCE(m.pr_coding_time,0)/60 coding, COALESCE(m.pr_deploy_time,0)/60 deploy
  FROM project_pr_metrics m
  WHERE m.pr_deployed_date IS NOT NULL AND m.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
    AND m.project_name IN (${project})
    AND (m.is_authored_by_bot IS NULL OR m.is_authored_by_bot IN (${author_type}))
    AND m.deployment_commit_id NOT LIKE '%01KTRWDKFENWZXRRF10DCEPRQ9%'
    AND $__timeFilter(m.pr_deployed_date)
), ev AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('github:GithubPullRequest:2:', rv.pull_request_id) pid,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_rev,
         MIN(CASE WHEN rv.state='APPROVED' AND rv.author_username NOT REGEXP '(\\[bot\\]|-bot|_bot)' THEN rv.github_submit_at END) first_appr
  FROM _tool_github_pull_request_reviews rv GROUP BY rv.pull_request_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT p.proj, p.cycle, p.coding, p.deploy,
    CASE WHEN e.first_rev IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, e.first_rev),0)/60 END pickup
  FROM prs_t p JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = p.id LEFT JOIN ev e ON e.pid = p.id
),
cm AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.5 THEN cycle END) v FROM (SELECT cycle, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cycle) rk FROM t) x),
mc AS (SELECT proj, MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.5 THEN cycle END) med FROM (SELECT proj, cycle, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY proj ORDER BY cycle) rk FROM t) x GROUP BY proj),
mp AS (SELECT proj, MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.5 THEN pickup END) med FROM (SELECT proj, pickup, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY proj ORDER BY pickup) rk FROM t WHERE pickup IS NOT NULL) x GROUP BY proj),
mcod AS (SELECT proj, MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.5 THEN coding END) med FROM (SELECT proj, coding, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY proj ORDER BY coding) rk FROM t) x GROUP BY proj),
mdep AS (SELECT proj, MAX(CASE WHEN rk<=0.5 THEN deploy END) med FROM (SELECT proj, deploy, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY proj ORDER BY deploy) rk FROM t) x GROUP BY proj),
base AS (SELECT proj, COUNT(*) n, SUM(cycle > (SELECT v FROM cm)) above FROM t GROUP BY proj)
SELECT b.proj 'Team', b.n 'PRs', ROUND(mc.med,1) 'Med cycle (h)', ROUND(mp.med,1) 'Med pickup (h)',
       ROUND(mcod.med,1) 'Med coding (h)', ROUND(mdep.med,1) 'Med deploy (h)',
       CAST(b.above - ROUND(b.n/2) AS SIGNED) 'Excess above company median'
FROM base b
JOIN mc ON mc.proj=b.proj LEFT JOIN mp ON mp.proj=b.proj LEFT JOIN mcod ON mcod.proj=b.proj LEFT JOIN mdep ON mdep.proj=b.proj
WHERE b.n >= 40 ORDER BY 7 DESC

options.content:
## How to read this dashboard

**Scope:** PRs by deploy date (same cohort as the DORA dashboard: a PR counts in the period its deployment finished); author scope follows the Author Type filter (default: Human); median-based; one known-bad deployment record (a months-long pipeline outage released as a single deploy) is excluded everywhere; its id is visible in the queries. Q2/2026 baseline and the OKR target (baseline minus 10%) are computed live from the Q2 dates; the red guide lines in charts are static approximations of the target.

**Stage definitions.** Coding: first commit to PR open (inflates with branch age; rebases keep authored dates). Pickup: PR open to first *human* review (bot reviews excluded via the raw review events, so this is correct even before the `pr_pickup_time` fix ships). Review to approval: first human review to approval. Approval to merge: approval to merged. Deploy: merged to deployed in production.

**Do not sum stage medians.** They are five separate middles of five separate distributions; the median PR of each stage is a different PR. Sum of stage medians is ~0.7h while the median lead time is ~21h, and both are correct. Use the band composition and the scenario panel instead; they keep each PR whole.

**Teams table:** PRs in multiple projects count once per project. Excess above company median: how many more of a team's PRs sit above the company median than a 50/50 split would put there; positive pushes the company median up.

Full investigation with interactive simulations: the *DORA Lead Time* Claude artifact. Companion explainer: *Why Stage Medians Don't Add Up*.
